reviews.title: It is not really your tree
reviews.text: Imagine you have your tree all nice and wonderful.  Then you look and it is all changed.  Yep.  People can change your tree.  It is potentially possible to change it back, but it is a hassle.

reviews.title: Printing 2 names
reviews.text: It is very frustrating when I live 2 hours away from the temple and I make several appointments for endowments but I can only take 1 family name.

reviews.title: Old Phone v Updates
reviews.text: Having to use my phone (iPhone 8) I am unable to download updates. Makes it hard to continue to use and it’s hard to find a desktop.. I get that done updates can’t work on my phone, but this latest update makes the app even harder to use.

reviews.title: Mobile app no good
reviews.text: The mobile app has many bugs when attaching family members with multiple IDs. They must have a way to concatenate them

reviews.title: More to be desired
reviews.text: The  website leaves a lot to be desired. It’s not the most reliable. Still lacking in over all family lineage information

reviews.title: Can’t make correction
reviews.text: This app won’t let you back up to make corrections when first putting in parents info. So now I’m looking at half brothers family above my father whom is still very much alive. And still can’t make correction so family from my mothers first marriage can be removed because I’m not related to them and add my fathers side of family to the tree. I’m not related to Woods family. Like my name says My family name is “Thomas”.

reviews.title: Not user friendly
reviews.text: Sometimes I can see historical records and sometimes I cannot. I can’t find a way to attach records. There are no useful help guides. I know my relatives have already added to this but I can’t connect with those. Duplicate records are created as a result. Waste of time in my opinion.

reviews.title: Living Family Members
reviews.text: Here’s my beef with Family Search…my own living children have different ID’s from my wife’s account as if they are completely different people. We are married and I search for my daughter with her ID on my wife’s family search account…no person found. This really should be better.

reviews.title: The updates have made the app harder to use
reviews.text:
Within the last month, the updates to this app have tremendously complicated the purpose of the app.  I can’t touch the screen to copy someone’s name.  When I am in my temple files and look at someone’s information, the app sends me back to the top of my list instead of back to where I last was located on the list.  The chat function shuts down the app.  Please revert to previous versions, this is making the Lord’s work very difficult and it seems that the programmers have done this on purpose.

UPDATE:  The changes have not been.  Continues to make working on it difficult.

2nd UPDATE:  Now when you try to find a birthplace or location of death, the page locks up.  How convenient!!  Fire the Programmers!!!!!

3rd UPDATE:  Still interrupting my searching.  Can’t stand it.

reviews.title: Confusing
reviews.text: I have worked with family search for many years. It is so frustrating to have application change after change. Instructions for the changes are never clear enough, and the results of those changes have sent me back generations with many hundreds of repair is based on the way the application “works“. I do not like the open access to all people since not all people are certified genealogist as I am, and their lack of understanding, and absolute ignorance of the way that records are found, and criticality of sources are often not included have absolutely derailed my research. People need to be accountable and there is no accountability in family search. I am a family history consultant. The current system (and display colors) are hard to follow. It is not only frustrating but embarrassing to try to teach. Please stick to the basics, require training, and let people make contributions after it is approved and accepted by the tree owner.
